info.prompt: Dynamic action sequence of a **Six-of-a-Kind chain** — **six gold one tiles** explode into **3000 points** as a **Standard Bomb** spawns with **crimson depleting ring**, its **3x3 radius** vaporizing adjacent **steel-blue fives** and damaging **dark granite Stone Blockers**. The **Gothic Bio-Architecture** framework trembles, **alabaster surfaces** cracking to reveal **obsidian chitin** beneath, while the **multiplier ladder** climbs to **×4.0** with a **cathedral bell toll**. The **terminal overlay** logs the provably fair HMAC-SHA256 seed verification process in **monospace glyphs**.
